findings.evidence: Line-weighted H2 classification: Load (5 lines) is expert routing; Choose the evidence scope (15) mixes expert corrections and activation; Git gotchas (6) mixes expert corrections and activation; Select and verify (8) is mostly expert procedure; Present (12) and NEVER (5) are predominantly activation. Those last two sections occupy 17/51 section lines with familiar reporting and evidence habits, including 'What changed', 'Why it matters', 'Next time' and 'NEVER cite a file, commit or line you did not read'.
findings.fix: Compact the reporting instructions and generic read-before-citing reminder into a shorter output/evidence contract, preserving all three required output parts. Retain the non-obvious Git corrections and signal-to-proof checks, which provide the strongest knowledge delta.

findings.evidence: The suite has the requested 10 positive and 10 negative queries, but all are terse, context-light requests such as 'what engineering takeaway is hiding in my recent refactor'. It lacks context-heavy queries with concrete repository paths, revision ranges or a reflection request embedded in a larger task.
findings.fix: Replace several terse queries with realistic contextual prompts containing file paths, revision ranges and PR details. Include a reflection request buried in a larger workflow and similarly detailed near-miss bug-review or commit-summary requests, preserving the balanced positive/negative split.

findings.evidence: The scope table routes 'On the base branch, or last N commits' to 'git log -p --first-parent -n <N>' with default N=5, but provides no route for an explicit revision range. The shipped precise-range eval asks 'Reflect on HEAD~3..HEAD', leaving preservation of that scope to inference.
findings.fix: Add an explicit revision-range row: inspect a supplied scoped log or diff directly; otherwise run git log -p --first-parent <range> using the requested endpoints without adding the default -n 5. State that an explicit range takes precedence over branch and recent-commit defaults.
